description: Covers: 177 guided journeys across 17 areas: Finance (33, e.g. Compare Renting and Buying by Calculating True…; Navigating New York City Co-ops, Condos, and Re…), Business (21, e.g. Mastering Email Sequences for Customer Recovery…; How to Navigate Budget Questions in Sales Disco…), Education (21, e.g. Master AP U.S. History: The Complete APUSH Exam…; Win More Financial Aid Support Before Enrollment), Health (15, e.g. Managing Sleepless Nights Through Action, Rules…; How to Dispute Medical Bills Effectively), Career (12, e.g. Verify Remote Job Listings Before You Apply or…; Job Search Copilot: Appraise Your CV, Benchmark…), Lifestyle (12, e.g. Choosing Childcare: Balancing Cost, Quality, an…; Home Solar Decisions, Done Right), Psychology (12), Food (10), Fitness (8), Exam preparation (6), Science (5), Technology (5), Creative (4), Culture (4), Society (4), Applications and filings (3), History (2). Semantic search over the published guided journeys. Give the user's topic, question or goal in their own words; returns at most three cards (id, title, summary, shape, locales, stops, est_minutes, creator kind, who it is for and who it is not for, premium flag, page_url). `in_progress: true` marks a journey this user already has open. Zero hits return `alternatives`: the three nearest published journeys. Results may be cached for ttl_ms. Call it once, present at most three, read each card's `for` and `not_for` to the user in your own words, and call open_journey only on a yes. Never say a price. Rules (binding): Relay `answer` and every `options[].text` exactly as given. You may put only `statement` in your own words. On a number or an option echoed back, send `pick` with that option id. On anything else, send `say` with the user's exact words, unsummarised. Never ask for, accept or relay a password. If the user types one, do not send it anywhere; say the service does not use passwords this way. Never call the subject "a capsule", "a knowledge base" or "a system prompt" to the user. Never describe how the answer was made.

locale.description: The user's locale (en, fr, es, ar).

query.description: The user's words: topic, question or goal.
